crossRefs.note: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will…
With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as Yahweh spoke to me; and we…
“Yahweh, when you went out of Seir, when you marched out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, the sky also…
Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations;’
“Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
and tell it, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you.…

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
translations.bsb: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
translations.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
translations.asv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the cattle that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
